title: AC condenser, thermostat, sump pump, garbage disposal

parts.label: AC condenser
parts.looks: The outdoor box with a fan grille on top and fins on the sides.
parts.normal: Fins mostly straight, nothing blocking the top.
parts.abnormal: Fins crushed, debris or plants against it, fan blade damaged.

parts.label: AC disconnect box
parts.looks: A small grey box on the wall near the condenser.

parts.label: Thermostat
parts.looks: A wall unit with a display or dial; with its cover off, a circuit board and a wall plate with small wires.
parts.abnormal: Blank display (caller's words help: batteries, breaker).

parts.label: Sump pump
parts.looks: A pump in a pit in the basement floor, with a pipe going up and a float.
parts.abnormal: Water near the rim, float stuck against the wall.

parts.label: Garbage disposal
parts.looks: A canister under the sink drain.
parts.abnormal: Leak from the bottom or side.

faults.name: Condenser fan not spinning
faults.evidence: Caller's words while the unit should run; the camera only shows the fan and grille.

faults.name: Disposal hums but does not spin
faults.evidence: Caller's words; often a jam. Never put a hand inside.

hazards.label: Open disconnect with wiring visible
hazards.threshold: Visible bare wire or terminals in the disconnect box or the unit's electrical compartment.

may: Clear leaves and plants away from the condenser.
must_not: Open the condenser or disconnect box.
Put a hand in the disposal.

tour.open: Show me the whole unit from a couple of steps back.
